verdict.rationale: Docs confirm hosted public status pages with custom domain support and a public JSON API (docs-18, docs-19, docs-38, docs-46), and status pages are tied to incident state per Rootly's incident platform. However, there is no explicit evidence of subscriber notification functionality (email/SMS alerts to status page subscribers). missing for 10: subscriber notification feature documentation, independent/hands-on confirmation of custom domain setup and notification delivery.
